comparison.objective: Fit a long wardrobe rail into closed and open supports using a tilt-in sequence.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part handling, end insertion, coordinated swing-down, and release; no adjustment or locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Left end inserted at least 0.8 cm, right end on its support, rail level within 1 degree and released still.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained long-part insertion, not adjustment followed by operational verification.
